description: Explicit product boundaries and review interpretation for @eliware/redact.

dos: Keep the package focused on redaction and safe serialization.
Treat path-local cycle tracking and depth-truncated Error metadata as intentional contracts when implementation and tests agree.
Compare review findings against the documented release scope and current behavior.
donts: Do not claim the package provides HTML sanitization, SQL sanitization, filesystem path sanitization, general input validation, encryption, secret storage, secret scanning guarantees, authentication, authorization, access control, data-loss-prevention enforcement, or memory/compiler sanitizers.
Do not treat documented boundary semantics as defects unless implementation contradicts the contract.
Do not treat speculative unreleased text rules or absent future modules as current implementation requirements.
Do not treat normalizeHeaderNames as a public exact-match policy API; redactHeaders applies matchHeuristics at the public boundary.
Do not require browser portability for Node.js Buffer handling or caller-configurable runtime marker fields.
